caption: Santa Caterina del Sasso, Leggiuno
composition: Cliffside hermitage Santa Caterina del Sasso on Lago Maggiore · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the lake, the camera looks up at the hermitage of Santa Caterina del Sasso clinging to its sheer cliff above Lago Maggiore in the clear 09:23 morning. Stone buildings with terracotta roofs cluster at center, tucked between dark cypresses against the grey rock face that towers on the left. The calm lake stretches to the right toward the hazy blue mountains, and the bright daylight picks out every stone of the little complex.
